fixture_corrections.note: The seeded conversation had revision 2, while the new-message test supplied 1. Corrected the fixture revision.

corrections.note: First archive journey used a nonexistent openCommands helper and old selectors. The commands journey also intercepted the old URL without visibility=all and reached its 240-second timeout. Corrected test helpers/selectors and expected URL; both final suites pass.

Added an actual computed-font assertion, which exposed CSP rejecting inline style injection: 14px remained instead of 28px. Replaced injection with a rule in an existing same-origin stylesheet, keeping CSP enabled. Applied and verified the same correction to the prior retry layout test. Earlier layout evidence is retained and does not establish enlarged-text coverage.

Inclusive metric total matched, but the fixture incorrectly required an older archived task on the first 50-row page. Search for that task within the inclusive scope before asserting its row; no production change for this failure.

browser.visual_review: Inspected light, dark and 1024px enlarged archive screenshots; controls and notices remain visible, and keyboard focus survives explicit rerender. Eight archive cases assert actual font size; eight retry cases also passed with corrected enlargement.
browser.isolation: Disposable databases, isolated browser contexts and synthetic models; no real model or business service is called.

limits: Archive is private organizational metadata and does not change execution facts, delete records or remove them from all-history totals.
The new table is initialized by normal Application startup. Read-only historical databases without it are treated as unarchived.
Unknown browser operation state is in memory only. Reload reads current server state and never replays the mutation.
Archive compare-and-set replay is valid only at the same state or immediately following accepted revision; older requests conflict.
Full and related backend counts overlap and are not additive.
Enlarged-text checks cover the affected archive and retry controls/notices, not uniform zoom of every page element.
No version bump, publication or repeated fresh installation.
